versions.content: Form a top-level RootSwCompositionPrototype When defining a software system, the AtomicSwComponentType is used in the form of SwComponentPrototype s within a CompositionSwComponent- Type . In this step, the non-service ports of all required interfaces are being connected using AssemblySwConnector s and DelegationSwConnector s in order to eventually form a top-level RootSwCompositionPrototype which can be ref- erenced in an AUTOSAR System .
